root_cause.text: In kvaser_usb_read_bulk_callback(), the URB is not re-anchored to dev->rx_submitted after being unanchored by the USB core, causing it to be missed during usb_kill_anchored_urbs() and resulting in a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "the USB framework unanchors the URB before the complete function is called. This means that once an in-URB has been completed, it is no longer anchored and is ultimately not released in usb_kill_anchored_urbs()." The patch adds `usb_anchor_urb(urb, &dev->rx_submitted);` in the callback to fix the leak.
